description: Ratchet for weighted test sharding vs hash-only partitions. imbalance_ratio = max_shard_weight / mean_shard_weight.

baseline.notes: Measured against seeded weights for the heavy crates listed in shard-weights.v1.json; hash sharding historically left vox-compiler+vox-gui on one shard.

usage: vox ci affected-crates --changed <list> --shards 3  (crate_weight loads contracts/ci/shard-weights.v1.json when present)
